theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ball p ρ ⊆ U → 1 ≤ k → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → μHE[n] ((T.support ∩ ball p ρ) \ R.carrier) = 0
